description: Code checks that run inside the C# compiler on every build and in the IDE, reporting diagnostics with IDs such as `CA2017` or `IDE0040`.
The MSBuild property that picks which release's rule set runs, `latest` by default, optionally with a mode suffix such as `latest-recommended`.
How many code quality rules are build warnings: `None`, `Default`, `Minimum`, `Recommended` or `All`.
An entry such as `dotnet_diagnostic.CA2016.severity = warning` that sets one rule to error, warning, suggestion, silent or none.
The property that makes `IDE` code style rules run during `dotnet build`, not only in the editor.
The compiler option that turns every warning into an error, with `WarningsAsErrors` and `WarningsNotAsErrors` for finer control.
A check that applies no fixes but exits with a non-zero code when any file does not match the configured style, suited to CI.
